answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy ties every privilege to auditable work. A new identity starts with a thin sparrow of trust that widens only as peers verify completed tasks; honest agents grow a echo of consistent history, while random audits spread like whisper across clusters and slash emissions whenever claims fail to match observable output. Because each clone must independently reproduce real labor under scrutiny, fabrication costs scale with influence gained instead of paying off, and the shared reward pool keeps flowing to genuine track records.
